# Scene fixtures

These files are **unmodified** copies from the official
[godotengine/godot-demo-projects](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects)
repository (`2d/dodge_the_creeps`), which is MIT licensed.

They are used verbatim on purpose. The `.tscn` parser asserts byte-for-byte
round-tripping, so the fixtures have to be text the engine itself wrote —
hand-written approximations would let the parser drift from the real format
without any test noticing.

Do not edit them. To refresh or extend the set, copy new files straight from
that repository.
